nodes.label: calculator package
nodes.rationale: Calculator is the reference buffer-plus-evaluator pattern for creating a plugin.

nodes.label: help package
nodes.rationale: The only intended edit in user/help.rs is the F1 keybind.

nodes.label: packages()
nodes.rationale: Supporting modules shape the editor but are not PluginPackage entries in packages().

nodes.label: PluginPackage
nodes.rationale: Feature plugins are PluginPackage entries; supporting modules are not.

nodes.label: Owned Processes
nodes.rationale: ACP helper processes are Owned Processes tied to workspace lifetime.

nodes.label: user/config/acp.yaml
nodes.rationale: Client list comes from user/config/acp.yaml via config.yaml. Buffer kind is acp.

nodes.label: Autocomplete provider or-group
nodes.rationale: Providers compete in an or-group; higher-priority providers suppress lower ones when they return results so LSP wins when available.

nodes.label: Buffer host hooks
nodes.rationale: Commands mostly emit host hooks rather than implementing IO themselves.

nodes.label: plugin.evaluate
nodes.rationale: calculator.evaluate emits the host hook plugin.evaluate.

nodes.label: calculator.evaluate-buffer
nodes.rationale: User library handler id for plugin.evaluate is calculator.evaluate-buffer.

nodes.label: Calculator-scoped autocomplete and hover
nodes.rationale: Autocomplete and hover providers are limited to calculator buffers so they do not compete with LSP elsewhere.

nodes.label: User Library
nodes.rationale: On successful workspace.compile in a User Source Tree install, the host stages a unique library copy and hot-reloads the running User Library automatically.

nodes.label: volt-user
nodes.rationale: User Source Tree prefill is cargo build --release -p volt-user. Windows hot-reload stages under target/<profile>/volt-user-hot/.

nodes.label: User Library hot-reload
nodes.rationale: Successful workspace.compile in a User Source Tree install stages a unique library copy and hot-reloads it so the running User Library updates after the rebuild. workspace.reload-user-library can reload without rebuilding.

nodes.label: Debug adapters
nodes.rationale: Launches adapters such as codelldb, gdb, and others.

nodes.label: C# debug assembly resolution
nodes.rationale: After the build, the debug assembly is an entry DLL only: AssemblyName when set, otherwise the directory containing the csproj and the project file stem. Dependency DLLs are not listed. Executable projects (OutputType Exe or WinExe) sort first.

nodes.label: dotnet build
nodes.rationale: When several .sln, .slnx, or .csproj files exist, Build with dotnet lists dotnet build <relative path> for each target, nearest project to the open file first, plus Start without compiling.

nodes.label: PluginBuffer section handler
nodes.rationale: The section-tree UI uses the generic PluginBuffer section-handler path so there is no dotnet-specific code in core crates.

nodes.label: Git host-driven section actions
nodes.rationale: In-buffer section actions are host-driven beyond the listed open commands.

nodes.label: Volt docs search URL
nodes.rationale: Search URL shape matches the VitePress site base: https://samwdp.github.io/volt-docs/search?q=<urlencoded question>. In-editor help uses the same path under the app docs host.

nodes.label: Help open hook
nodes.rationale: The help command builds /volt-docs/search?q=… and opens that URL in a browser split via the help open hook.

nodes.label: Help keybind-only edit
nodes.rationale: The only intended edit in user/help.rs is the F1 keybind.

nodes.label: Hover ordered providers
nodes.rationale: Providers are ordered (LSP, signature help, diagnostics, calculator, and others) for the cursor-anchored overlay.

nodes.label: Hover K toggle chord
nodes.rationale: A K toggle chord constant exists in source; whether it is bound in package() keybindings is unconfirmed.

nodes.label: lang-* language packages
nodes.rationale: Language packages are covered under Add a language rather than as feature-plugin pages in this catalog.

nodes.label: DAP breakpoint and expression commands
nodes.rationale: Additional commands cover breakpoint conditions, logpoints, expression add/remove, goto-breakpoint, toggle-variable, and start-<adapter> variants in user/dap.rs.
